name: dsh-plugin-zcode-ability
description: ZCode capability container for DeepSeek Harness. Holds no logic of its own: it carries the declarative patch that mounts its six component packages (dsh-plugin-zcode-{persona,skills,plan,workflow}, dsh-plugin-zcode-environment, dsh-plugin-z.ai-account) and the ported ZCode skill tree (skills/).
